_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fsi_xfem#1 and a FALSIFICATION of its Signal. The entry claimed cut elements with tiny volume fractions give cond(K) > 1e16 and make direct LU fail. On the upstream monolithic deck xfsi_3D_boxes, which solves with UMFPACK, neither GHOST_PENALTY_STAB: false nor GHOST_PENALTY_FAC: 0.0 produces any solver complaint: both complete the Newton loop, reach 'Checking results of 7 tests' and fail six of them (structure dispx moves from 8.89e-05 to 8.68e-05 in the zero-factor arm). No condition number, singular-matrix or factorisation message is emitted in either arm. Ghost penalty changes the answer quietly; the loud failure the entry described does not occur here. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the on/off arm: leave ghost penalty enabled. That arm becomes the baseline and its six failures vanish, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the scaling arm: keep the upstream ghost-penalty factor. ZEROFAC_RESULT_FAILURES drops to 0, so the fixture must go red.
